messages:
nightdash-bot: [ALERT] Nightly perf alert for staging-serving-runtime · 99th latency +18% vs baseline (since 01:12 UTC). Affected route: /v1/generate (model: open-lr-13B). Dashboard: https://dash/redwood/nightly/185987 — please triage.
alex_m: saw this in the dashboard, looks like prefetch hit-rate dropped ~30% and KV miss rate jumped.
maria_r: confirming. ran a quick profile on a noisy shard — more frequent kernel churn and ~2x smaller avg batch sizes. attaching summary in thread.
ben_liu: CI perf gate for the same commit also tripped earlier: https://ci.redwood/builds/7842 (throughput down 12%). likely related.
sasha: i ran a short flame on staging. prefetch worker metrics show requests being routed to the cold path sometimes — the prefetch to cache handoff isn't happening for ~15% of flows. suspect routing heuristic change.
alex_m: that explains smaller batches -> more kernel switches -> tail latency. do we have a recent change touching routing/prefetch?
maria_r: PR #2421 "route-heuristic-v2" merged yesterday (commit 0ab12c7). it changed the routing scoring and added a fallback that can reroute to a different pool.
ben_liu: bisect idea: check before/after 0ab12c7; CI already hints post-commit regressions. sasha can you run a focused bisect on staging? this should be quick if we restrict to routing service.
sasha: starting bisect now. will narrow to the exact commit window and test prefetch handoff metric. ETA ~30m.
alex_m: if bisect confirms, we should either revert the PR or toggle rollout to legacy policy. can we gate via env flag?
ben_liu: yes, we have an env override. quick patch (hotfix) to force legacy routing:

kubectl set env deploy/prefetch WORKER_ROUTING=legacy -n staging
kubectl rollout restart deploy/prefetch -n staging

will push as hotfix if needed.
maria_r: prepping release hold on the RC until we see bisect results. I'll notify release management and put the canary on pause. @eng-oncall FYI.
ci-bot: Build 7842 shows perf regression at 2026-11-06T01:05:22Z; metric: throughput p50 -9%, p99 +18% vs baseline.
ben_liu: if hotfix stabilizes, we'll plan a revert PR for #2421 with note about routing heuristics needing more gating.
sasha: bisect update: isolated to commit 0ab12c7 -> changes in route scoring caused ~15% of small-req flows to bypass prefetch due to an accidental strictness in pool-compat check. reproducer script attached.
alex_m: good catch. sasha, can you include the minimal repro steps and the metric graph so we can attach to the revert PR?
sasha: yes. repro steps:
```
# run synthetic load with short seq len
python perf/repro/run.py --model open-lr-13B --concurrency 40 --seq 32 --seed 42
# collect prefetch hit-rate from /metrics/prefetch
curl http://staging-metrics/prefetch | jq '.hit_rate'
```
maria_r: i'm authorizing the rollback if we see the hotfix restore metrics. ben, please prepare revert PR and mark as rollback.
ben_liu: will open PR now, link to CI and bisect notes.
alex_m: plan of action:
- sasha: finalize bisect notes + repro
- ben: open revert PR + hotfix env override
- maria: hold RC and notify stakeholders
- i'll monitor nightly after canary hotfix

maria_r: :thumbsup: thanks everyone, please post updates here.
nightdash-bot: update: hotfix env applied to canary at 01:47 UTC. monitoring metrics.
alex_m: initial canary numbers look promising — prefetch hit-rate back within 2% of baseline, batch sizes recovered.
nightdash-bot: final update: nightly run at 02:30 UTC shows p99 back to baseline and throughput restored. closing alert, recommend merging revert PR after approvals.
ben_liu: opened revert PR #2475 with bisect notes + tests to cover pool-compat edge-case. link: https://git.redwood/reverts/2475
maria_r: i'll follow up with postmortem doc and add a checklist item for routing feature flags in rollouts.
alex_m: thanks all. moving to postmortem and follow-ups.
